Method of Attack: Requesting superuser permissions due to a coding error in the WhiteOps SDK embedded in the Facebook Android app, causing popups asking for full device access
Impacted Systems: Facebook Android app (com.facebook.katana) on rooted Android phones
Attack Vector: Embedded SDK in Facebook Android app triggering superuser permission popups
Indicators of Compromise: Superuser permission popups originating from Facebook Android app versions 172.0.0.12.93 and v172.0.0.66.93
